sentences.en: Hello, this is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 你好,这是6分钟英语 从英国广播公司学习英语。

sentences.en: I'm Phil. And I'm Georgie. We hear a lot about the difficulties young men face growing up in the modern world, and how many of them are looking online for answers.
sentences.zh: 我是菲尔,我是乔治,我们经常听到 年轻人在现代世界成长时所面临的困难 以及他们当中有多少人在网上寻找答案

sentences.en: This has created a situation which has been given the name 'the manosphere'.
sentences.zh: 这造成了一种被命名为“人际圈”的情况。

sentences.en: What exactly is the manosphere? Here's Anita Rani, presenter of BBC Radio 4's Woman's Hour, with one definition: The manosphere consists of online communities and influencers that promote the idea that emotional control, material wealth, physical appearance and dominance, especially over women, are markers of male worth.
sentences.zh: 这是英国广播公司第四电台“妇女一小时”节目的主持人Anita Rani, 只有一个定义:“人际圈”由在线社群和影响力人士组成,他们宣扬情感控制、物质财富、外表和主导地位,特别是妇女,是男性价值的标志。

sentences.en: The manosphere describes attitudes expressed online that men are superior.
sentences.zh: 人文圈描述的是在网上表达的 男性优越的态度。

sentences.en: You won't find any website named www.manosphere.com, but in social media posts, TikTok videos and other online content, ideas about how to be a man are finding a young male audience, sometimes with damaging results.
sentences.zh: 但社会媒体文章、TikTok影片及其他网络内容中, 有关如何成为男性的想法正在寻找年轻男性观众,

sentences.en: In this episode we'll hear from Will Adolphy, a young British man who followed the manosphere until, in his mid-twenties, he suffered a breakdown.
sentences.zh: 在这集中,我们会听到威尔・阿道夫, 一个年轻的英国人 谁跟随人际圈直到, 在他20多岁中, 他遭受崩溃。

sentences.en: And as usual, we'll learn some useful new words and phrases.
sentences.zh: 和往常一样,我们会学习一些有用的新词和新词。

sentences.en: And remember – you'll find all the vocabulary from this episode on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 并记住-你会在我们的网站上找到这集的词汇,bbc学习英语.com。

sentences.en: But first, I have a question for you, Georgie.
sentences.zh: 但首先 我有个问题要问你 乔治

sentences.en: According to men's self-help group the Movember Foundation, a majority of British young men regularly engage with masculinity influencers online, but how many exactly?
sentences.zh: 根据男性自助团体Movember基金会的资料, 大多数英国年轻人经常在网上与男性影响者接触, 但究竟有多少人?

sentences.en: Is it: a) two thirds, b) three quarters, or c) eight tenths?
sentences.zh: 是:(a) 三分之二,(b) 四分之三,还是(c) 八分之十?

sentences.en: I'm going to guess a) two thirds. OK. Well, we'll find out the answer later in the programme.
sentences.zh: 好吧 我们稍后在节目里会找出答案的

sentences.en: The manosphere includes the idea that the world is biased against men.
sentences.zh: 人际圈包括一种观念,即世界对男人有偏见。

sentences.en: According to the social media influencers who promote these views, being a man means being strong, rich and controlling others, especially women.
sentences.zh: 根据宣传这些观点的社交媒体影响者的说法,男子意味着强大、富有和控制他人,特别是妇女。

sentences.en: As a young boy, Will Adolpy was unlike other boys at school, and as he grew into a teenager, he started engaging with some of these ideas.
sentences.zh: 作为一个小男孩, Will Adolpy 与学校里的其他男孩不同, 当他长大成人时, 他开始接触一些这些想法。

sentences.en: Here, he tells BBC Radio 4 programme Woman's Hour how it all started: I didn't quite fit in the box – you know, I was doing ballet, I wanted to be an actor, I wrote poetry – and I was an easy target.
sentences.zh: 他告诉BBC电台4节目“妇女一小时”是如何开始的:我不太适合在盒子里——你知道,我在做芭蕾舞,我想做一个演员,写诗——我是一个容易的目标。

sentences.en: By the time I got to 14 years old, if you look at pictures of me, you can see bravado, you can see a mask – I see it.
sentences.zh: 当我到14岁的时候, 如果你看看我的照片, 你可以看到狂欢, 你可以看到一个面具——我看到了它。

sentences.en: I unknowingly did my best to adhere to what we call the 'man box', which is a kind of rigid set of ideals and rules that I may feel pressure as a boy to follow, in order to be a quote unquote 'real man'.
sentences.zh: 我不知不觉地尽我最大的努力 坚持我们所谓的"男人盒子", 这是一种僵硬的 一套理想和规则, 我可能会感到压力 作为男孩,

sentences.en: The teenage years can be difficult for someone who's different.
sentences.zh: 青春岁月对不同人来说可能很困难

sentences.en: Will enjoyed poetry and ballet, and he says this made him an easy target – someone who's vulnerable and easily taken advantage of.
sentences.zh: 威尔喜欢诗歌和芭蕾, 他说这让他很容易成为目标 — — 一个脆弱和容易利用的人。

sentences.en: Will responded with bravado – a show of bravery to impress other people but which often hides someone's true feelings.
sentences.zh: 将用狂欢回应 — — 勇敢的表演让其他人印象深刻,但这种表演往往掩盖了某人的真实感受。

sentences.en: He felt pressure to present himself as a quote unquote 'real man'.
sentences.zh: 他感到压力 把自己 引为一句"真正的男人"的引号

sentences.en: The phrase quote unquote can be used to show you're repeating someone else's words, especially if you don't agree with them.
sentences.zh: 引号不引号可以用来表示 你重复别人的话 特别是如果你不同意的话

sentences.en: But behind the bravado, Will struggled to get a girlfriend or hold down a job.
sentences.zh: 但是在狂欢之后 Will拼命想找个女朋友或者保住工作

sentences.en: Offline, his life seemed to reflect messages he saw in the videos he was watching online: that his problems were caused by women.
sentences.zh: 他的生活似乎反映了他在网上观看的视频中看到的信息:他的问题是由妇女造成的。

sentences.en: Here's Will again, sharing more with BBC Radio 4's Woman's Hour: When I went online to search for answers, I had an influencer telling me, "The world hates men," which really felt true.
sentences.zh: 这是威尔,与BBC电台4的“妇女时刻”分享更多信息:当我上网寻找答案时,我有一个影响力者告诉我,“世界憎恨男人”,这确实让人感到真实。

sentences.en: And it, kind of, distorted my worldview, where it got painted over – this whole brush … where I started to feel that was really true: that everyone hates men, so it was an us versus them.
sentences.zh: 它,有点扭曲了我的世界观, 它在那里被涂抹—— 整个刷子... 我开始觉得这是真的: 每个人都讨厌男人, 所以这是我们和他们之间的对立。

sentences.en: Will's view of the world became distorted – twisted out of shape and unrealistic.
sentences.zh: 威尔对世界的看法被扭曲了 扭曲了形状和不现实。

sentences.en: He started seeing everyone as an enemy. Will says he painted everyone with the same brush – an idiom meaning to unfairly think everyone has the same bad qualities as a certain person.
sentences.zh: 他开始把每个人都视为敌人。 威尔说,他用同样的刷子给每个人画画 — — 一种不公平地认为每个人都有和某个人一样的劣质。

sentences.en: Will saw the world as us versus them – a phrase which is used to show hostility between two opposing groups: in this case, the men in the manosphere and everyone else, especially women, progressives and the mainstream media, who he believed wanted to limit their power.
sentences.zh: 威尔(Will)将世界视为我们和他们之间的对立 — — 这句话用来表达两个对立群体之间的敌意:在这种情况下,男性在地圈,其他人,特别是妇女、进步派和主流媒体,他认为他们想限制他们的权力。

sentences.en: Luckily for Will, his experiences in the online world of the manosphere ended, but not before his mental health had declined to the point of a breakdown.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是,威尔,他在网上的 人际圈世界的经历结束了, 但不是在他心理健康 下降到崩溃点之前。

sentences.en: Now, he visits schools around the UK telling his story to young people, reminding them always to question what they see and hear online.
sentences.zh: 现在,他访问英国各地的学校,向年轻人讲述他的故事,提醒他们总是质疑他们在网上看到和听到什么。

sentences.en: OK. Phil, I think it's time to reveal the answer to your question.
sentences.zh: 好吧,菲尔,我想是时候 透露你的问题的答案了

sentences.en: Yes, I asked you how many British young men regularly engage with masculinity influencers online?
sentences.zh: 是的,我问你有多少英国年轻人 经常与男性影响者 在线接触?

sentences.en: And I said a) two thirds. …which was the correct answer.
sentences.zh: 我说,a) 三分之二。...这是正确的答案。

sentences.en: Well done! Thank you. OK. Let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with an easy target – a vulnerable person who is easily taken advantage of.
sentences.zh: 做得好!谢谢。好。让我们回顾一下我们学到的词汇,从一个容易的目标开始 — — 一个容易被利用的脆弱者。

sentences.en: Bravado is a show of bravery or confidence to impress people.
sentences.zh: 布拉瓦多是一种勇敢或自信的表现 来给人们留下深刻印象。

sentences.en: The phrase quote unquote can be used to show you are repeating someone else's words, especially if you do not agree.
sentences.zh: 引号未引用的语句可以用来表示您重复了别人的语句,特别是如果您不同意的话。

sentences.en: Something which is distorted has become misshapen so that it looks strange or unnatural.
sentences.zh: 被扭曲的东西 已经变成了错误的哈彭 所以它看起来怪异或不自然。

sentences.en: The phrase us versus them is used to show hostility between two opposing groups.
sentences.zh: 我们和他们之间的对立是用来显示两个对立群体之间的敌意。

sentences.en: And finally, if you paint everyone with the same brush, you unfairly think everyone has the same bad qualities of one person.
sentences.zh: 最后,如果你用同样的刷子给每个人画画, 你不公平地认为每个人都有同一个人的坏品质。

sentences.en: Once again, our six minutes are up, but if you enjoyed this episode, why not check out the worksheet and quiz, both available now at bbclearningenglish.com!
sentences.zh: 再一次,我们的六分钟 到了,但如果你喜欢这集, 为什么不检查工作表和测验, 现在都在bbclearingenglish.com!

sentences.en: Goodbye for now! Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见,再见
